requirements.title: lease_timeout and reap_interval configuration
requirements.rationale: A bad deadline setting must stop hub at start rather than produce leases that never lapse or a reaper that spins.

criteria.condition: the [sandbox] section is loaded without lease_timeout or reap_interval
criteria.action: set LeaseTimeout to 5 minutes and ReapInterval to 10 minutes on the validated configuration as time.Duration values
criteria.contract: Validated.LeaseTimeout == 5*time.Minute and Validated.ReapInterval == 10*time.Minute

setup: a minimal valid sandbox.Config with no lease_timeout and no reap_interval
check.pseudocode: v, err = Validate(cfg); assert err == nil; assert v.LeaseTimeout == 5*time.Minute; assert v.ReapInterval == 10*time.Minute

criteria.condition: the [sandbox] section sets lease_timeout and reap_interval to valid Go duration strings
criteria.action: decode both keys, treat them as recognised keys that are never reported as unknown, and store the parsed durations, accepting the boundary values lease_timeout = 1s, lease_timeout = max_ttl, reap_interval = 10s and reap_interval = 1h
criteria.contract: Validate returns a nil error and the parsed durations

setup: a TOML file with max_ttl = 1h and a [sandbox] section
check.pseudocode: for (lt, ri) in [(1s,10s),(1h,1h),(90s,30s)]: cfg = LoadConfig(write(lt, ri)); v, err = Validate(cfg); assert err == nil; assert v.LeaseTimeout == parse(lt); assert v.ReapInterval == parse(ri)

criteria.condition: lease_timeout cannot be parsed as a Go duration, is below 1s, or is above max_ttl
criteria.action: report a failure naming sandbox.lease_timeout, joined with every other [sandbox] validation failure, so hub refuses to start
criteria.contract: Validate returns a non-nil error whose text contains "sandbox.lease_timeout" and every other collected failure

setup: a config that also has a second invalid key, for example an unknown runtime
max_ttl = 1h
check.pseudocode: for bad in ['abc','999ms','2h']: _, err = Validate(cfg(lease_timeout=bad, runtime='bogus')); assert err != nil; assert 'sandbox.lease_timeout' in err.Error(); assert 'sandbox.runtime' in err.Error()

criteria.condition: reap_interval cannot be parsed as a Go duration, is below 10s, or is above 1h
criteria.action: report a failure naming sandbox.reap_interval, joined with every other [sandbox] validation failure, so hub refuses to start
criteria.contract: Validate returns a non-nil error whose text contains "sandbox.reap_interval" and every other collected failure

setup: a config that also has a second invalid key
check.pseudocode: for bad in ['xyz','9s','61m']: _, err = Validate(cfg(reap_interval=bad, runtime='bogus')); assert err != nil; assert 'sandbox.reap_interval' in err.Error(); assert 'sandbox.runtime' in err.Error()

criteria.condition: the configuration file has no [sandbox] section
criteria.action: read neither lease_timeout nor reap_interval and report no failure for them
criteria.contract: sandboxes.Init returns a nil service and a nil error

setup: a config file with no [sandbox] section
check.pseudocode: svc, err = Init(logger, path, factory); assert svc == nil; assert err == nil

requirements.title: Lease deadline column, field and capacity
requirements.rationale: A lease must carry a fixed deadline that callers can see and that capacity respects without waiting for a sweep.

criteria.condition: POST /workspaces/:slug/sandboxes succeeds
criteria.action: store lease_expires_at as the earlier of created_at + lease_timeout and expires_at, written with apikit.FormatUTC
criteria.contract: HTTP 201 body field lease_expires_at equals FormatUTC(min(created_at + lease_timeout, expires_at))

setup: an in-memory SQLite database with the lease schema and migration
an injected clock
lease_timeout 5m
check.pseudocode: r1 = post(ttl=1h); assert r1.lease_expires_at == FormatUTC(created+5m); r2 = post(ttl=2m); assert r2.lease_expires_at == r2.expires_at

criteria.condition: hub starts, whether or not the feature is enabled
criteria.action: add a nullable TEXT column lease_expires_at to sandbox_leases right after the lease schema is created, checking PRAGMA table_info first so that a second run changes nothing, leaving existing rows NULL, and doing nothing on a nil database
criteria.contract: the migration returns nil on first and repeated runs; pre-existing rows read lease_expires_at NULL

setup: a sandbox_leases table created without the column and holding one row
check.pseudocode: assert Migrate(db) == nil; assert Migrate(db) == nil; assert count(pragma, 'lease_expires_at') == 1; assert select(lease_expires_at) IS NULL; assert Migrate(nil) == nil

criteria.action: include a lease_expires_at key in every lease representation (POST 201 body, GET one, the workspace list, the all=true list and the admin list), holding an RFC 3339 string or null for a row with a NULL column
criteria.contract: each lease JSON object has the key lease_expires_at with a string or null value; the exact-key-set test of spec 26 lists it

setup: one lease issued with a deadline and one legacy row with NULL lease_expires_at
check.pseudocode: for rep in [post, get_one, list, list_all, admin_list]: assert 'lease_expires_at' in rep; assert legacy.lease_expires_at is None; assert parse_rfc3339(new.lease_expires_at)

criteria.action: for any lease and any sequence of transitions applied to it (Create, DELETE, Close, sweep, shutdown, restart recovery), keep lease_expires_at equal to the value written when the lease was issued
criteria.contract: the stored lease_expires_at equals the value written at issue after every step

setup: a lease service, gateway backend, sweeper and shutdown over an in-memory database with an injected clock
check.pseudocode: for ops in gen_op_sequences(): l = issue(); v0 = l.lease_expires_at; for op in ops: apply(op); assert read(l.id).lease_expires_at == v0

criteria.action: exclude from the live-lease count every leased lease whose lease_expires_at is at or before now, including a deadline exactly equal to now, in addition to the exclusions spec 26 already makes
criteria.contract: a POST that would exceed max_sandboxes only because of such leases is accepted with HTTP 201

setup: max_sandboxes = 1
one leased lease whose lease_expires_at is before now, and in a second case exactly equal to now
an injected clock
check.pseudocode: seed(leased, lease_expires_at=now); assert post().status == 201; reset(); seed(leased, lease_expires_at=now+1s); assert post().status == capacity_error

requirements.title: Deadlines enforced at hub's gateway
requirements.rationale: A token must never outlive its deadline because of how often the reaper runs.

criteria.condition: a Create arrives at hub's gateway for a lease in state leased and the lease's lease_expires_at, or its expires_at when lease_expires_at is NULL, is at or before now
criteria.action: refuse the Create without calling the provider and, in the same call, end the lease through the expiry path as expired with end_reason expired
criteria.contract: gRPC FailedPrecondition whose message contains "expired"; a GET of the lease immediately after reads state expired and end_reason expired; exactly one hub.sandbox.expire event with state expired; provider Create count unchanged

setup: a leased lease whose lease_expires_at is before the injected now and no sweep has run
a recording provider double
an in-process gatewayd server with hub's backend and a real gateway client
check.pseudocode: clock.advance_past(lease_expires_at); err = client.Create(); assert code(err) == FailedPrecondition; assert 'expired' in msg; assert provider.creates == 0; assert get(id).state == 'expired'; assert count(events, 'hub.sandbox.expire') == 1

criteria.condition: a request presents the token of a lease whose expires_at is at or before now, in any lease state
criteria.action: reject the token
criteria.contract: the RPC fails with gRPC Unauthenticated

setup: leases in leased, active, destroyed-with-token and failed-with-token style rows whose expires_at is at or before now but whose token hashes are still stored
check.pseudocode: for state in [leased, active, expired, failed]: seed(state, expires_at=now, keep_token=True); assert code(rpc(token)) == Unauthenticated

criteria.condition: a lease has been ended through the expiry path
criteria.action: reject the lease's token because its hash was cleared by the ending
criteria.contract: every later RPC with that token fails with gRPC Unauthenticated

setup: a leased lease with a valid token that has been ended through the expiry path by a sweep
check.pseudocode: sweep(); assert code(client.Create()) == Unauthenticated; assert code(client.Close()) == Unauthenticated; assert token_hash(id) is NULL

criteria.condition: the lease leaves state leased (expired by a sweep or deleted) while the provider is creating its box
criteria.action: destroy the box it just created and keep the terminal state and end_reason the lease already has
criteria.contract: gRPC FailedPrecondition naming the lease's current state; provider Destroy called once with the new box's ID; the lease's state and end_reason are unchanged by the Create

setup: a provider double whose Create blocks until released
a leased lease with a valid token
check.pseudocode: start create in goroutine; wait provider.entered; delete(lease); provider.release(); err = join(); assert code(err) == FailedPrecondition; assert provider.destroyed == [box.id]; assert get(id).end_reason == 'api'

criteria.action: for any interleaving of a late Create and a sweep on the same lapsed lease, end the lease exactly once
criteria.contract: exactly one hub.sandbox.expire event for the lease and one state change to expired

setup: a leased lease past its lease_expires_at
check.pseudocode: for schedule in gen_schedules(): setup(); run_concurrently(create, sweep, sweep, order=schedule); assert count(events, id) == 1; assert get(id).state == 'expired'

requirements.title: The sweep
requirements.rationale: One idempotent, serialised function enforces every time-based ending and cleans up what other paths leave behind.

criteria.condition: a sweep runs
criteria.action: read the time from hub's injected clock and run, in order, provider Reap, the lapse of unused leases, the destruction of overdue boxes, the removal of orphaned boxes, the pruning of old leases and the recalibration of the active gauge
criteria.contract: the recording provider observes Reap before List; pruning and recalibration happen after the endings of the same sweep

setup: a recording provider double logging every call in order
an active overdue lease, a lapsed leased lease, an old terminal lease and a gauge value that disagrees with the table
check.pseudocode: sweep(); assert idx(calls,'Reap') < idx(calls,'List'); assert row_deleted_after_endings; assert gauge('ws') == count(active)

criteria.condition: a sweep step returns an error
criteria.action: log the error with slog and still run every later step
criteria.contract: the sweep function returns after all six steps; later steps' effects are observable

setup: a provider whose Reap and List both return errors
an overdue active lease, a lapsed leased lease and an old terminal lease
a captured slog handler
check.pseudocode: provider.reap_err = E; provider.list_err = E; sweep(); assert get(leased).state == 'expired'; assert get(old) is None; assert len(error_logs) >= 2

criteria.condition: a sweep finds a lease in state leased whose lease_expires_at, or expires_at when lease_expires_at is NULL, is at or before now
criteria.action: end the lease through the expiry path as expired with end_reason expired, without calling the provider
criteria.contract: the lease reads expired with end_reason expired; exactly one hub.sandbox.expire event with metadata state expired; its token fails with Unauthenticated

setup: one leased lease with lease_expires_at before now
one legacy leased lease with NULL lease_expires_at and expires_at before now
one leased lease with a future deadline
check.pseudocode: sweep(); assert get(a).state == 'expired' and get(b).state == 'expired'; assert get(c).state == 'leased'; assert provider.destroys == 0; assert count(expire_events) == 2

criteria.condition: a sweep finds a lease in state active whose expires_at is at or before now
criteria.action: call provider Destroy for its sandbox_id and then end the lease through the expiry path as destroyed with end_reason expired
criteria.contract: the provider's List no longer contains the box; the lease reads destroyed with end_reason expired; exactly one hub.sandbox.expire event with metadata state destroyed and the sandbox_id; no hub.sandbox.destroy event

setup: an active lease with a real box in the provider double (or AgentKit local)
the clock advanced past expires_at
check.pseudocode: sweep(); assert box.id not in provider.List(); l = get(id); assert l.state == 'destroyed' and l.end_reason == 'expired'; assert events == [expire(state=destroyed, sandbox_id=box.id)]

criteria.condition: provider Destroy fails for an overdue active lease during a sweep
criteria.action: still end the lease as destroyed with end_reason expired and clear its token hash, and log the lease ID, the sandbox ID and the error text after the internal/sandboxes URL-userinfo scrubber
criteria.contract: the lease reads destroyed; its token fails with Unauthenticated; one log record carries lease_id, sandbox_id and the scrubbed error

setup: an overdue active lease
a provider whose Destroy returns an error containing https://user:pw@host/x
a captured slog handler
check.pseudocode: provider.destroy_err = Err('GET https://user:pw@host/x failed'); sweep(); assert get(id).state == 'destroyed'; r = find_log(lease_id=id); assert r.sandbox_id == sid; assert 'user:pw' not in r.error

criteria.condition: the sweep's orphan step lists the provider's boxes
criteria.action: call Destroy for each listed box whose ID equals the sandbox_id of a terminal lease in this hub's table or, when the listing exposes labels, whose hub.lease label names such a lease, and never call Destroy for a box of a leased or active lease, a box without a hub.lease label, or a box whose lease ID this hub does not know
criteria.contract: provider Destroy is called exactly for the matched box IDs

setup: a provider listing boxes: B1 whose ID equals the sandbox_id of a destroyed lease, B2 whose hub.lease label names an expired lease, B3 belonging to an active lease, B4 with no hub.lease label, B5 labelled with a lease ID unknown to this hub
a second run where the listing exposes no labels
check.pseudocode: sweep(); assert set(provider.destroyed) == {B1, B2}; assert B3 not in destroyed and B4 not in destroyed and B5 not in destroyed

criteria.condition: a sweep is requested while another sweep is in progress
criteria.action: serialise the sweeps so that no two sweeps run at the same time, and skip without emitting any event every lease that another path has already ended
criteria.contract: the maximum number of concurrently running sweeps observed is 1; no lease receives a second ending event

setup: a provider double whose Reap blocks briefly and records the concurrent in-flight count
overdue leases
check.pseudocode: parallel(10, sweep); assert provider.max_inflight_reap == 1; for l in leases: assert count(events, l.id) == 1

criteria.condition: a provider call (Reap, List or Destroy) made by the sweep does not return within 30 seconds
criteria.action: cancel that call's context at 30 seconds, log the timeout, and continue with the next item and step
criteria.contract: the sweep returns within the per-call limit (configurable to a short value in tests) and the later steps still take effect

setup: the per-call limit configured to 50ms
a provider whose Reap, List and one Destroy block until their context is cancelled
a lapsed leased lease, an overdue active lease and an old terminal lease
check.pseudocode: cfg.callTimeout = 50ms; t0 = now(); sweep(); assert now()-t0 < 2s; assert get(leased).state == 'expired'; assert get(old) is None

requirements.title: Restart recovery and the reaper loop
requirements.rationale: Boxes from an earlier process cannot be relayed to, and expiry must run without any caller.

criteria.condition: hub starts with the feature enabled
criteria.action: after the lease schema and migration, the audit emitter and the metrics exist and before hub's gateway accepts a connection, call provider Destroy for the box of every lease in state active and end each such lease as destroyed with end_reason restart
criteria.contract: each such lease reads destroyed with end_reason restart before the gateway listener accepts; one hub.sandbox.destroy event per lease with reason restart, ActorType system and empty ActorID

setup: two active leases and one leased lease left by an earlier process
an audit emitter recording events
a gateway listener that records when it begins accepting
check.pseudocode: startup(); assert all(get(l).end_reason == 'restart' for l in active); assert recovery_done_at < listener_accept_at; for e in events: assert e.metadata.reason == 'restart' and e.actor_type == 'system' and e.actor_id == ''

criteria.condition: provider Destroy fails during restart recovery
criteria.action: log the scrubbed error, still end the lease as destroyed with end_reason restart, and continue starting
criteria.contract: the lease reads destroyed; hub start-up proceeds; a later sweep's orphan step calls Destroy for the box

setup: an active lease whose provider Destroy fails once and whose box still exists
a captured slog handler
check.pseudocode: provider.destroy_err_once = Err; recovery(); assert get(id).state == 'destroyed'; sweep(); assert provider.destroy_calls[box.id] == 2

criteria.condition: restart recovery has finished
criteria.action: run one sweep, then run a sweep every reap_interval until shutdown begins (the reaper context is cancelled)
criteria.contract: with an injected ticker, one sweep per tick is observed and none after cancellation

setup: an injected ticker factory
a counting sweep observed through provider Reap
check.pseudocode: r = StartReaper(ctx, tickers); assert reaps == 1; for i in 3: tick(); wait(); assert reaps == 4; cancel(); join(r); tick(); assert reaps == 4

criteria.condition: restart recovery or a sweep returns an error at start
criteria.action: log the error and return it to the caller instead of terminating the process
criteria.contract: hub start-up continues; no os.Exit or log.Fatal is called from internal/sandboxes

setup: a provider whose Destroy, Reap and List all fail
check.pseudocode: err = RunStartup(); assert err is not None; assert logged(err); assert reaper.running()

criteria.condition: gatewayd calls Reap on hub's backend
criteria.action: run the sweep when the context carries no lease principal, and return nil without calling the provider or the sweep when it carries one
criteria.contract: Reap returns nil in both cases; the sweep count increases only for the principal-less call

setup: hub's backend with a counting sweep and a recording provider
check.pseudocode: assert backend.Reap(ctx) == nil; assert sweeps == 1; assert backend.Reap(withPrincipal(ctx,'L1')) == nil; assert sweeps == 1; assert provider.calls_after == provider.calls_before

criteria.condition: the feature is disabled
criteria.action: run no restart recovery, no sweep and no reaper loop, and leave every sandbox_leases row unchanged
criteria.contract: the lease table is identical before and after start

setup: a database holding active, leased and old terminal rows
a configuration with no [sandbox] section
check.pseudocode: before = dump(leases); wire(disabled); tick_many(); assert dump(leases) == before

requirements.title: Retention of terminal leases
requirements.rationale: An ended lease must stay visible long enough to explain what happened to it, and no longer.

criteria.condition: a terminal lease ended 24 hours or less before now, where ended means ended_at or updated_at when ended_at is NULL
criteria.action: keep the lease readable through GET one, GET /workspaces/:slug/sandboxes?all=true and the admin list, including after a sweep, and treat a lease that ended exactly 24 hours before now as still retained
criteria.contract: GET one answers HTTP 200 with the lease; the all=true and admin lists contain it

setup: terminal leases ended 23h ago, exactly 24h ago, and one with NULL ended_at whose updated_at is 23h ago
check.pseudocode: sweep(); for l in leases: assert get(l.id).status == 200; assert l.id in list_all and l.id in admin_list

criteria.condition: a sweep runs and a terminal lease ended more than 24 hours before now
criteria.action: delete the lease row
criteria.contract: GET one for the lease answers HTTP 404; the all=true and admin lists no longer contain it

setup: a destroyed, an expired and a failed lease each ended 24h plus 1s ago, and one with NULL ended_at whose updated_at is 25h ago
check.pseudocode: sweep(); for l in old: assert get(l.id).status == 404; assert l.id not in list_all

criteria.action: for any lease in state leased or active, never delete its row, whatever its age
criteria.contract: the row still exists afterwards (it may have changed to a terminal state)

setup: a lease table with leases of random states and ages
check.pseudocode: for rows in gen_rows(states=[leased, active], age=any): seed(rows); sweep(); for r in rows: assert exists(r.id)

requirements.title: Shutdown
requirements.rationale: Nothing hub leased may keep running after hub stops, and a hung provider must not block termination.

criteria.condition: server.Start() returns
criteria.action: run the sandbox shutdown before the audit database and the SQLite database close, bounded by a 20-second limit
criteria.contract: the shutdown function returns within 20 seconds; both databases are still open while it runs

setup: hub's main wiring with a fake server whose Start returns immediately
audit and SQLite handles that record when they are closed
check.pseudocode: run_main(fake_server); assert order == ['shutdown_start','shutdown_end','auditDB.Close','database.Close']; assert shutdown_limit == 20s

criteria.condition: hub is in shutdown mode
criteria.action: refuse every new Create without calling the provider, and end every lease ended for any reason with end_reason shutdown
criteria.contract: Create fails with gRPC Unavailable; provider Create count unchanged; leases ended in this mode read end_reason shutdown

setup: a leased lease and an active lease
hub in shutdown mode
check.pseudocode: EnterShutdown(); assert code(client.Create()) == Unavailable; assert provider.creates == 0; delete(active); assert get(active).end_reason == 'shutdown'

criteria.condition: the sandbox shutdown runs
criteria.action: cancel the reaper loop and wait for any sweep in progress to return, then call provider Destroy (concurrently allowed) for the box of every active lease and end each as destroyed with end_reason shutdown, then stop hub's gateway through gatewayd.Server's stop
criteria.contract: each active lease reads destroyed with end_reason shutdown; one hub.sandbox.destroy event per lease with reason shutdown, ActorType system and empty ActorID; no sweep starts after shutdown begins

setup: a running reaper
three active leases
a gateway server double recording its stop
check.pseudocode: Shutdown(ctx); for l in active: assert get(l).end_reason == 'shutdown'; assert reaper.stopped; assert gateway.stop_at > last_end_at; tick(); assert sweeps_after == sweeps_at_start

criteria.action: leave every lease in state leased unchanged, including its token hash and deadlines
criteria.contract: leased rows are byte-identical before and after shutdown

setup: a lease table with random leased rows beside active rows
check.pseudocode: for rows in gen_leased_rows(): before = dump(rows); Shutdown(ctx); assert dump(rows) == before

criteria.condition: provider Destroy hangs so the 20-second limit runs out
criteria.action: return when the limit expires and leave the leases whose ending has not completed in state active for restart recovery
criteria.contract: shutdown returns within the limit (configurable to a short value in tests); unfinished leases read active

setup: the shutdown limit configured to 100ms
a provider whose Destroy blocks forever for one lease's box and succeeds for another
check.pseudocode: limit = 100ms; t0 = now(); Shutdown(); assert now()-t0 < 1s; assert get(hung).state == 'active'; assert get(ok).state == 'destroyed'

criteria.condition: the sandbox shutdown is called a second time, or is called while the feature is disabled
criteria.action: return without calling the provider and without changing any lease
criteria.contract: shutdown returns nil; provider call counts and the lease table are unchanged

setup: a completed shutdown with a recording provider
a disabled-feature sandbox handle
check.pseudocode: Shutdown(); n = provider.calls; snap = dump(); assert Shutdown() == nil; assert provider.calls == n; assert dump() == snap; assert disabled.Shutdown() == nil

requirements.title: Events and end reasons
requirements.rationale: Each ending must produce exactly one audit event that says why it happened, and none may leak a secret.

criteria.action: define EventSandboxExpire = "hub.sandbox.expire" in internal/audit/types.go with a doc comment listing its metadata keys lease_id, state and sandbox_id
criteria.contract: audit.EventSandboxExpire == "hub.sandbox.expire"

check.pseudocode: assert audit.EventSandboxExpire == 'hub.sandbox.expire'

criteria.condition: the expiry path ends a lease
criteria.action: emit one hub.sandbox.expire event with ResourceType sandbox, ResourceID the lease ID, Action expire, ActorType system, empty ActorID, Workspace the slug, and Metadata lease_id, state (expired or destroyed) and sandbox_id only when a box was destroyed
criteria.contract: one audit.HubEvent with these fields

setup: a recording emitter
a leased lease and an active lease with a box
check.pseudocode: e1 = expire(leased); assert e1.metadata == {lease_id, state:'expired'}; e2 = expire(active); assert e2.metadata == {lease_id, state:'destroyed', sandbox_id}

criteria.action: emit no hub.sandbox.destroy for an expiry-path ending, and emit hub.sandbox.destroy with reason shutdown or restart and ActorType system for shutdown and restart endings
criteria.contract: per ending exactly one of hub.sandbox.expire or hub.sandbox.destroy

setup: leases ended by a late Create, a sweep, shutdown and restart recovery
check.pseudocode: for cause in [late_create, sweep_lapse, sweep_overdue, shutdown, restart]: ev = events_for(lease); assert len(ev) == 1; assert ev[0].type == expected[cause]

criteria.condition: the conditional ending update affects no row because another path already ended the lease
criteria.action: emit no event and record no metric for that attempt
criteria.contract: event count and metric values are unchanged by the skipped attempt

setup: an active lease that DELETE ended just before the sweep reaches it, the sweep holding a stale snapshot
gauge and histogram values recorded before the attempt
check.pseudocode: snapshot = list_overdue(); delete(l); events0 = count(); g0 = gauge(); hist0 = hist_count(); sweep_with(snapshot); assert count() == events0; assert gauge() == g0; assert hist_count() == hist0

criteria.condition: the emitter is nil or Emit returns an error
criteria.action: skip emission when nil, log an Emit error with slog.Error, and still complete the ending
criteria.contract: the lease reads its terminal state; the caller receives the same result as with a working emitter

setup: a lapsed leased lease in each of three setups: working emitter, nil emitter, emitter returning an error
a captured slog handler
check.pseudocode: for em in [ok, nil, failing]: r = expire(lease, em); assert r == baseline; assert get(id).state == 'expired'

criteria.action: for any event, log line or lease field written by this spec, contain no secret value, environment value, lease token or token hash, and pass provider error text through the internal/sandboxes URL-userinfo scrubber before logging it
criteria.contract: captured events, log records and lease rows contain none of the injected secret values, env values, tokens or token hashes; logged provider error text has URL userinfo removed

setup: leases created with random secret values, env values and tokens
captured events, slog output and database rows
a provider whose Destroy errors embed URL userinfo
check.pseudocode: for l in gen_leases_with_secrets(): run_all_flows(l); blob = events + logs + rows; for s in l.secrets + l.env_values + [l.token, l.token_hash]: assert s not in blob; assert not re.search('://[^/@]+@', logs)

requirements.title: Sandbox metrics
requirements.rationale: Operators need to see how many boxes run, how Creates turn out and how long leases last.

criteria.condition: audit.NewMetrics is called
criteria.action: register afhub_sandboxes_active (gauge, label workspace, pre-initialised with label ""), afhub_sandbox_creates_total (counter, label result, pre-initialised at zero for created and failed) and afhub_sandbox_lease_seconds (histogram, no labels, buckets 60, 300, 600, 1200, 1800, 3600, 7200, 14400, 28800) on the metrics registry
criteria.contract: GET /metrics lists all three names before any lease exists

setup: a fresh audit.NewMetrics()
the /metrics handler
check.pseudocode: body = get('/metrics'); for n in names: assert n in body; assert 'afhub_sandbox_creates_total{result="created"} 0' in body; assert 'le="28800"' in body

criteria.condition: a lease moves from leased to active, or an ending changes a lease that was active
criteria.action: increment afhub_sandboxes_active for the lease's workspace by one on activation and decrement it by one on that ending
criteria.contract: the workspace's gauge value changes by +1 or -1

setup: a lease in workspace ws
a Metrics instance
check.pseudocode: create(); assert gauge('ws') == 1; delete(); assert gauge('ws') == 0

criteria.condition: hub starts with the feature enabled and restart recovery has finished, or a sweep reaches its last step
criteria.action: call Reset() on afhub_sandboxes_active and then Set one value per workspace from a GROUP BY count of active leases
criteria.contract: the gauge equals the per-workspace count of active rows

setup: active leases in two workspaces
gauge values deliberately wrong, including a stale workspace label
check.pseudocode: gauge.set('stale', 9); sweep(); assert gauge_series() == {ws1: n1, ws2: n2}

criteria.condition: the gateway accepts a Create for a leased lease
criteria.action: increment afhub_sandbox_creates_total once, with result created when the lease becomes active and result failed on a provider error, secret_missing, or a lease that left leased while its box was being created
criteria.contract: exactly one of the two result series increases by 1

setup: leases for a successful create, a provider error, a missing required secret, and a lease deleted during box creation
